# 3D asset fixtures: provenance

`triangle.gltf` was written by hand for this project (its `asset.generator` field says
`gungnir testdata`): one triangle, positions and normals inline as a base64 buffer.
Nothing was copied from any sample-model collection, so no third-party licence
attaches. It exercises the glTF loader in `gungnir-data` and is never linked into or
shipped with a binary.
